description: The IM3 project deposits package inputs for CERF, a Python model that locates feasible future electricity capacity expansion. Zenodo lists one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. Its description enumerates contiguous-US state boundaries and a 1 km state raster, gas pipeline and substation shapefiles, technology suitability rasters, interconnection costs, regional price zones, illustrative hourly locational prices and YAML configuration files. The linked CERF repository is BSD-2-Clause and documents scenario-driven plant siting. These inputs can run demonstration capacity-planning and grid siting simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this CERF input package. A limitation is that its 8,760-hour price file is explicitly fake and illustrative, not observed market data. EIA and HIFLD spatial inputs retain their own upstream attribution and rights, which were not independently reviewed. Source dates in the description reach 2020, so infrastructure locations may be stale. The ZIP was not downloaded and no suitability surface was recalculated.
